notes: Hand-built 5-reaction model (no rule, OR of two transcripts, single gene, AND rule, gene in two reactions); both expected matrices ('' and '.') derived by hand from the rules. Covers default SeparateTranscript/printLevel (progress display) and the two input-parser errors (numeric SeparateTranscript, text printLevel). The existing test/verifiedTests/analysis/testMTA/testMTA.m also calls calculateGeneKOMatrix (3 asserts) but its function under test is MTA (with rMTA), so it is not a test of this function alone; a new file was written (III-Naming). showprogress (already a ledger edge) is called only when printLevel > 0. The progress display creates the global WAITBAR_HANDLE; the test removes new globals at the end. deleteModelGenes' two cosmetic defects (wave 35) are not reached: the transcripts passed always exist in the model and are never already marked deleted.

defects.title: A list of absent genes none of which is in the model stops with an error
defects.trigger: integrateGeneExpressionData(model, 99) (also dataGenes = [] or [99; 98]) for a model whose genes contain none of the numbers
defects.observed: (R2025a, 2026-11-23) MATLAB:UndefinedFunction "Unrecognized function or variable 'ExpressionData'." at line 40: ExpressionData is created only inside the loop when a transcript matches
defects.expected: the model returned unchanged (no gene to constrain)

defects.title: A gene identifier that is not a number stops the call for two or more absent genes
defects.observed: (R2025a, 2026-11-23) MATLAB:sizeDimensionsMustMatch "Arrays have incompatible sizes for this operation." at line 28: str2num('b0001') is [] and a non-scalar dataGenes == [] fails (a scalar dataGenes skips the gene)
defects.expected: the non-numeric gene skipped, as for a scalar dataGenes

notes: Reproduction (error defect): model = createModel({'R1'; 'R2'}, {'R1'; 'R2'}, {' -> A'; 'A -> '}, 'grRuleList', {''; '535.1'}); integrateGeneExpressionData(model, 99) -> Unrecognized function or variable 'ExpressionData' (line 40). Same for [] and [99; 98]. Reproduction (limitation): model = createModel({'R1'; 'R2'; 'R3'}, {'R1'; 'R2'; 'R3'}, {' -> A'; 'A -> B'; 'B -> '}, 'grRuleList', {''; '535.1'; 'b0001'}); integrateGeneExpressionData(model, [535; 7]) -> Arrays have incompatible sizes (line 28). Severity 'error' follows the precedent 'Errors when no gene qualifies' (findGenesAbove/BelowThresholdLocal1/2, error, quarantined). If the lead reclassifies it as limitation, the full test is cheap: probes confirmed [535; 7] deletes 535.1, 535.2 and 7 and zeroes R2 (OR of both 535 transcripts) and R4; 1548 deletes 1548.1 and blocks the AND rule '1548.1 and 20.1'; duplicates in dataGenes work; an empty gene name is skipped (line 27). No src caller (no one else blocked). Line 30 (Genes2Transcripts) and 39 are dead assignments (unused variables).
confirmed_by: lead (read the code: ExpressionData is created only inside the loop when a listed gene matches (lines 29-34), so with no match deleteModelGenes(model, ExpressionData.Transcript) at line 40 stops; no src caller)
